'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Shumaker DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Shumaker]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
